create_test_options: create a TestOptions instance to configure argparse arguments for audio-visual enhancement testing
run_test_inference: run test inference by initializing TestOptions and parsing arguments for video and audio input paths
configure_audio_separation: configure audio separation parameters including hop length, spectrogram type, and mask compression settings
setup_visual_features: setup visual feature extraction with lipmotion, identity, or both feature types for audio-visual model
parse_test_arguments: parse test arguments with GPU selection, batch size, and data paths from TestOptions
